tools.name: get_temperature

tools.name: core_memory_append
tools.description: Appends a specified content to a section of the core memory. Supports all Unicode characters, including emojis.

content.description: The content to append to the memory. Can include any Unicode character, such as text and emojis.

name.description: The section of the memory to be edited. Valid sections are 'persona' for character traits and 'human' for human-like experiences.

request_heartbeat.description: If true, requests an immediate heartbeat to verify the memory update. Useful for confirming that subsequent messages or functions are executed in response to the update.

tools.name: core_memory_replace
tools.description: Replaces the contents of a specific section in the core memory. To delete specific memories, provide an empty string for the new_content parameter.

name.description: The section of the memory to be edited. Possible sections include 'persona' or 'human'.

new_content.description: The new content to write into the memory. Supports all Unicode characters, including emojis. Use an empty string ('') to signify memory deletion.

old_content.description: The string to be replaced. This must be an exact match of the memory content to be replaced.

request_heartbeat.description: Requests an immediate heartbeat after the function execution. Set to true to ensure the system is responsive for follow-up actions.

tools.name: recall_memory_search
tools.description: Search the conversation history for a specific string and return the matching results. This can be used to reference past conversations or retrieve information previously discussed.

page.description: Defines the page number of the search results to return, allowing pagination through a large set of results. The first page is 0.

query.description: The keyword or phrase to search within the conversation history.

request_heartbeat.description: When set to true, triggers an immediate heartbeat after the search function completes. Useful for initiating follow-up actions or checks.

tools.name: archival_memory_insert
tools.description: This function adds a new entry to the archival memory, ensuring the content is formatted in a manner conducive to future queries and retrievals.

content.description: The information to be archived. Accepts any unicode text, including emojis. Format the content clearly to aid in effective querying.

request_heartbeat.description: When set to true, triggers an immediate heartbeat to confirm successful execution. Useful for initiating follow-up actions.

tools.name: archival_memory_search
tools.description: Performs a semantic search on archival memory data, utilizing embeddings to find relevant content based on the provided query string.

page.description: Specifies the page number in the search result pagination. It is zero-indexed, where 0 represents the first page.

query.description: The search phrase used to query the archival memory. It should be a coherent string of text.

request_heartbeat.description: Determines whether to request an immediate heartbeat after function execution, useful for initiating a follow-up action.

tools.name: http_request
tools.description: Generates an HTTP request of a specified type to the provided URL, including an optional payload, and returns the response.

headers.description: Optional headers to be included in the HTTP request. Common headers include 'Content-Type' and 'Authorization'.

Authorization.description: Authentication credentials for the request, such as 'Bearer <token>' or 'Basic <credentials>'.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the request body, typically 'application/json'.

method.description: The HTTP method to be used for the request.

payload_json.description: A JSON-formatted string representing the request payload. This should be in a proper JSON structure, encoded as a string.

request_heartbeat.description: If set to true, signals that an immediate heartbeat should be requested after the function's execution. Useful for confirming connectivity or the successful completion of the request.

url.description: The target URL for the HTTP request.

tools.name: add
tools.description: Performs the addition of two integers and returns the result.

a.description: The first integer to be added.

b.description: The second integer to be added.

tools.name: my_core_function
tools.description: Performs a computation using the user's name and returns a customized message.

name.description: The name of the user for which the computation is performed.

tools.name: sub
tools.description: Subtracts one integer from another and returns the result.

a.description: The first number from which the second number will be subtracted.

b.description: The second number to subtract from the first number.

tools.name: fahrenheit_to_celsius
tools.description: Convert a temperature from Fahrenheit to Celsius.

fahrenheit.description: The temperature in degrees Fahrenheit that needs to be converted to Celsius.

tools.name: celsius_to_fahrenheit
tools.description: Converts a given temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit.

celsius.description: The temperature in degrees Celsius to be converted to Fahrenheit.

tools.name: duck_duck_go.search
tools.description: Performs a search using the Duck Duck Go Search API. It is useful for retrieving answers to questions about current events. The input is a search query string, and the output is a JSON array containing the search results.

no_html.description: A flag to prevent HTML content in the response. Set to true if HTML should be stripped from the results.

no_redirect.description: A flag to prevent redirection to external websites. Set to true if the redirection should be skipped.

query.description: The search query string to be submitted to the Duck Duck Go Search API.

tools.name: get_tesco_locations
tools.description: Retrieve a list of the nearest Tesco stores based on the specified location, typically used for finding convenient shopping options.

limit.description: The maximum number of Tesco store locations to return.

location.description: The city and state of the user's location, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'City, Country'.

radius.description: The search radius in miles around the specified location within which to find Tesco stores.

tools.name: get_news_report
tools.description: Retrieves the latest news for a specified location formatted as 'City, State'.

location.description: The location for which to retrieve the news, in the format of 'City, State' or 'Location, Country', such as 'San Francisco, CA', 'Paris, France', or 'New York, NY'. If using state name, only then use short form for state.

tools.name: todo_delete
tools.description: Deletes a todo item from the list based on the specified content.

content.description: The text content of the todo item to be identified and deleted.

tools.name: todo.add
tools.description: Creates a new todo entry in the list with the provided content.

completed.description: Flag indicating whether the todo item is completed.

content.description: The text content of the todo item to be added.

due_date.description: The due date for the todo item in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'.

priority.description: The priority level of the todo item.

tools.name: todo.update
tools.description: Update a specific to-do item identified by its old content with new content in the to-do list.

new_content.description: The new content that will replace the old content of the identified to-do item.

old_content.description: The original content of the to-do item that needs to be updated. This is used to find and identify the specific item in the to-do list.

tools.name: get_interviewer_list
tools.description: Retrieve a list of interviewers who are qualified based on a specific skill set.

availability.description: Filter for interviewers who are currently available.

experience_level.description: The required experience level for the interviewers.

skill.description: The skill for which to find qualified interviewers, such as 'Python', 'Data Analysis', or 'System Design'.

tools.name: review_of_interviewer
tools.description: Retrieve the average rating and reviews for a specified interviewer based on their full name.

include_comments.description: Flag to determine whether to include text comments in the response.

interviewer_name.description: The full name of the interviewer to fetch reviews for, e.g., 'Jane Doe'.

tools.name: run_microwave
tools.description: Activates the microwave to run at a specified power level.

mode.description: The cooking mode such as 'defrost', 'grill', 'convection', or 'microwave'.

power_level.description: The power level at which the microwave should operate.

tools.name: oven_preheat
tools.description: Preheat the oven for a specified duration at a given temperature.

duration.description: The duration in minutes to preheat the oven.

temperature.description: The temperature in degrees Fahrenheit to preheat the oven.

tools.name: get_pods
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all pods within a specified namespace in a Kubernetes cluster.

field_selector.description: A selector to restrict the list of returned objects by their fields. Defaults to everything if not specified.

include_uninitialized.description: If true, partially initialized resources are included in the response.

label_selector.description: A selector to restrict the list of returned objects by their labels. Defaults to everything if not specified.

namespace.description: The namespace from which to retrieve pods. For example, 'default' or 'kube-system'.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all services available in the specified namespace of the system.

namespace.description: The namespace identifier from which services are to be fetched.

tools.name: TransactionsV2
tools.description: Process a financial transaction by recording the debit and credit amounts, vendor information, and the date of the transaction.

credit.description: The amount credited to the account in US dollars. Only one credit amount is recorded per transaction.

date.description: The exact date when the transaction occurred, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

debit.description: The amount debited from the account in US dollars. Only one debit amount is recorded per transaction.

vendor.description: The vendor name or description associated with the transaction.

tools.name: Alltransactions
tools.description: Retrieve a list of all transactions for a specified statement period.

include_pending.description: A flag to determine if pending transactions should be included in the list.

statement_period.description: The statement period for which transactions are to be retrieved, in the format 'YYYY-MM'.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Retrieve the official name of the company as registered or doing business as (DBA), typically used in formal documentation.

company_name.description: The official name or DBA (Doing Business As) of the company. This should be the legal name used in contracts and formal agreements.

tools.name: collect_customer_names
tools.description: Gathers the full name of a customer and the associated company name for account identification purposes.

company_name.description: The legal name of the company with which the customer is associated. Provide the full registered name. If the company name is not applicable or unknown, leave blank.

firstname.description: The first name of the customer as recorded on official documents.

lastname.description: The surname or family name of the customer as recorded on official documents.

middlename.description: The middle name of the customer, if any, as recorded on official documents. Leave blank if the customer does not have a middle name.

tools.name: ClientAddress.set_address
tools.description: Sets the full address for a client profile.

full_address.description: The complete address of the client, including street, city, state, and postal code, in the format 'Street, City, State, Postal Code' (e.g., '1234 Elm St, Springfield, IL, 62704').

tools.name: TotalTransactions.calculate
tools.description: Calculates the total number of transactions, including deposits and withdrawals, within a given time period and computes the starting and ending balance.

ending_balance.description: The balance of the account at the end of the transaction period in dollars.

ending_date.description: The ending date for the transaction period, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-31T23:59:59Z').

starting_balance.description: The balance of the account at the start of the transaction period in dollars.

starting_date.description: The starting date for the transaction period, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z').

total_deposits.description: The total amount of deposits made during the transaction period in dollars.

total_withdrawals.description: The total amount of withdrawals made during the transaction period in dollars.

tools.name: BankStatementOverView
tools.description: Provides an overview of a bank statement, including account information and a summary of transactions for a specific period.

account_number.description: The unique identifier for the account, typically found at the top of the statement.

account_type.description: The classification of the account, such as 'checking', 'savings', or 'credit'.

bank_name.description: The official name of the bank as it appears on the bank statement.

full_name.description: The complete name of the account holder as recorded by the bank.

transaction_overview.description: A summary of transactions within the statement period, including totals and counts.

end_date.description: The ending date of the statement period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

start_date.description: The starting date of the statement period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

total_deposits.description: The total amount deposited in the account during the statement period, in dollars.

total_withdrawals.description: The total amount withdrawn from the account during the statement period, in dollars.

tools.name: transaction_summary.generate
tools.description: Generates a summary of financial transactions over a given period, including individual transactions and totals.

company_name.description: The official name or DBA of the company associated with the account, if applicable.

ending_balance.description: The balance of the account at the end of the transaction period, in USD.

ending_date.description: The ending date for the transaction period, in ISO 8601 format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

middlename.description: Middle name of the customer, if applicable.

starting_balance.description: The balance of the account at the start of the transaction period, in USD.

starting_date.description: The starting date for the transaction period, in ISO 8601 format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

total_deposits.description: The total amount of deposits made during the transaction period, in USD.

total_withdrawals.description: The total amount of withdrawals made during the transaction period, in USD.

transactions.description: A list of individual transaction details, each transaction includes the amount debited or credited, the associated vendor, and the date.

tools.name: inventory_management
tools.description: Manage inventory-related queries, including checking product availability, stock updates, size availability, color availability, and bulk availability. It returns the current stock status for a given product ID, sizes, and color, and verifies if the desired quantity is available for bulk orders.

color.description: Color of the product to check for stock updates. Expected format is a color name, such as 'red' or 'blue'.

product_id.description: Unique identifier of the product for which the inventory is being queried.

quantity.description: Quantity of the product for bulk availability checks. Must be a non-negative number.

sizes.description: List of sizes to check for stock updates, such as ['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL'].

tools.name: product_search
tools.description: Search for products based on a variety of criteria such as category, color, and size.

category.description: The category of the product to filter search results. For example, 'electronics', 'clothing', or 'books'.

color.description: The color of the product to filter search results. For example, 'red', 'blue', or 'green'.

size.description: The size of the product to filter search results. Expected values could be 'small', 'medium', 'large', or specific sizes like 'S', 'M', 'L' for clothing.

tools.name: order_status_check
tools.description: Check the current status of an order by providing the order ID and the product name.

order_id.description: The unique identifier of the order.

product.description: The name of the product associated with the order.

tools.name: interviewer_review.get
tools.description: Retrieves the ratings and reviews of an interviewer based on their full name.

name.description: The full name of the interviewer, formatted as 'First Last'.

tools.name: get_show_times
tools.description: Retrieves a list of movie show times based on the specified location, movie, and date.

cinema_hall.description: The name of the cinema hall, for example 'PVR Logix', 'SARV Cinemas', 'PVR SCT City Centre', 'Miraj Cinemas'.

city.description: The city where the movie will be shown, such as 'Noida', 'Amritsar', or 'Indore'.

movie_date.description: The date when the movie is showing. Accepts values like 'today', 'tomorrow', '24th Feb', 'Monday', 'Sunday'. The format expected is 'DD MMM' (e.g., '24 Feb') or a day of the week.

movie_format.description: The viewing format of the movie, such as '2D', '3D', '4DX', '2D Screen X', 'ICE', 'IMAX 2D'.

movie_language.description: The language in which the movie is available, e.g., 'Hindi', 'English', 'Malayalam', 'Telugu', 'Punjabi'.

movie_name.description: The title of the movie for which show times are being requested, for example 'Fighter', 'Article 370', 'Crakk', 'Teri Baaton Mein Aisa Uljha Jiya'.

tools.name: get_movie_details
tools.description: Retrieve the detailed information of a specified movie. The function returns data such as the title, release year, genre, and director of the movie.

include_reviews.description: Specifies whether to include user reviews in the movie details.

language.description: The language in which to retrieve the movie details. Default is English (EN).

movie_name.description: The exact title of the movie for which details are being requested, such as 'The Shawshank Redemption' or 'Inception'.

tools.name: todo.list_action
tools.description: A function to manage a todo list, including adding new items, deleting existing items, or marking items as completed.

content.description: The content or description of the todo item that is subject to the action specified by the 'type' parameter.

type.description: The action to perform on the todo list. Possible actions are 'add' to add a new item, 'delete' to remove an item, and 'complete' to mark an item as completed.

tools.name: todoIdx
tools.description: Provides functionality for managing a todo list, including the ability to delete an item or mark an item as complete based on its index in the list.

index.description: The zero-based index of the todo item in the list that the specified operation should be applied to.

type.description: The operation to perform on the todo item. 'delete' will remove the item from the list, while 'complete' will mark the item as completed.

tools.name: add_postgres_server
tools.description: Add a new PostgreSQL server configuration or update an existing one with the provided settings.

database.description: The name of the target database on the PostgreSQL server. If not provided, defaults to 'postgres'.

host.description: The hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL server.

password.description: The password for authentication with the PostgreSQL server.

port.description: The port number on which the PostgreSQL server is running. Defaults to the standard PostgreSQL port.

username.description: The username for authentication with the PostgreSQL server.

tools.name: add_mtnards_server
tools.description: Add a new MTNA Rich Data Services (RDS) server to the configuration, allowing interaction with the server using the provided API key.

api_key.description: The API key used for authenticating with the MTNA RDS server. This key should be kept confidential.

host.description: The hostname or IP address of the server. For example, '192.168.1.10' or 'server.example.com'.

nickname.description: The server's name or nickname that will be used for identification within the environment.

tools.name: dartfx_help
tools.description: Provides assistance by returning the documentation links and usage instructions for the DartFX library.

output_format.description: The format in which the help information should be returned, such as 'text', 'HTML', or 'PDF'.

topic.description: The specific topic or function within DartFX for which help is requested. For example, 'installation', 'configuration', or 'troubleshooting'.

tools.name: list_servers
tools.description: Retrieves a list of servers from the specified environment, filtered by the server type if provided.

nickname.description: The nickname represents the type of server to filter the list by. If not specified, all server types will be listed.

tools.name: help_me
tools.description: Provide help, assistance, and guidance on a specified topic to the user.

include_resources.description: Flag to indicate if additional resources like links to guides or tutorials should be included in the help response.

topic.description: The topic for which help is being requested, such as 'email setup', 'software installation', 'account recovery', etc.

urgency.description: The urgency level for the help request.

tools.name: default.add_default_value
tools.description: Adds a default value to a dictionary if the specified key does not exist, ensuring that updates do not overwrite existing entries.

default_value.description: The value to set for the key if it does not exist in the dictionary. The type of this value can be any valid Python data type.

dict.description: The dictionary to which the default value should be added.

key.description: The key for which the default value is to be set.

tools.name: render_ui_single_select_widget
tools.description: Renders a single-select UI widget with a heading and a list of selectable options.

heading.description: The text displayed as the heading for the single-select widget.

options.description: An array of strings representing the selectable options.

tools.name: render_ui_multi_select_widget
tools.description: Renders a multi-select widget with a specified heading and a list of selectable options for the user interface.

default_selection.description: An array of strings representing the default selected options when the widget is rendered. This parameter is optional.

disabled.description: A flag to indicate whether the multi-select widget is disabled (not interactive) by default. This parameter is optional.

heading.description: The text displayed as the heading of the multi-select widget.

options.description: An array of strings representing the options available for selection in the multi-select widget.

tools.name: render_ui_date_picker_widget
tools.description: Renders a date picker widget on the UI that allows the user to select a single date.

default_date.description: The initial date selected in the date-picker widget. This should be in the format of 'dd-mm-yyyy', such as '31-12-2023'.

tools.name: render_ui_finish
tools.description: Invoke this function to display the final list of available flight options to the user once all necessary information has been gathered.

default_date.description: The default date set in the date-picker, in the format of 'dd-mm-yyyy', such as '15-04-2023'.

tools.name: default_function
tools.description: This function provides default behavior when specific functionality has not been implemented.

action.description: The action to be executed by the function. Should be a descriptive verb.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds the function should wait before timing out.

verbose.description: A flag to indicate whether to run the function in verbose mode, providing detailed logs.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Open an existing Data Artife project located in the specified directory. This function initializes the project environment and loads the configuration files.

path.description: The absolute or relative file system path to the directory where the project is located. Example: '/users/username/projects/project1'

read_only.description: Specifies whether the project should be opened in read-only mode. When set to true, no changes can be made to the project.

tools.name: close_project
tools.description: Close the current data artifex project and archive its contents.

archive.description: Determines whether the project should be archived after closing.

notify_users.description: Whether to notify all users associated with the project about its closure.

project_id.description: The unique identifier of the project to be closed.

tools.name: connect_to_server
tools.description: Establishes a connection to the specified server or checks the status of an existing connection.

nickname.description: A unique identifier or alias for the server to connect to.

retry_attempts.description: The number of attempts to connect to the server in case of failure.

timeout.description: The maximum time in seconds to wait for the connection to be established before timing out.

use_ssl.description: Determines whether to use SSL encryption for the connection.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List all the files within the current project directory. Optionally, list files of a specific type only.

file_type.description: The specific file type to list, such as 'txt' for text files or 'md' for markdown files. Provide the extension without the dot.

include_hidden.description: Whether to include hidden files (those starting with a dot) in the listing.

recursive.description: Whether to recursively list files in all subdirectories.

tools.name: rename_server
tools.description: Renames a server by changing its current identifier to a new one provided by the user.

_from.description: The current server identifier, such as a hostname or IP address.

to.description: The new server identifier to which the server will be renamed. This should be unique and adhere to naming conventions.

tools.name: acl_api.add_mapping
tools.description: Adds an Access Control List (ACL) mapping to define permissions for a user or group.

permissions.description: The level of access being granted.

principal_id.description: The unique identifier for the user or group.

resource_id.description: The unique identifier of the resource for which access is being defined.

tools.name: acl_api.delete_mapping
tools.description: Removes an ACL (Access Control List) mapping for a specified team and project.

projectUuid.description: The UUID of the project for which the ACL mapping is to be removed.

teamUuid.description: The UUID of the team for which the ACL mapping is to be removed.

tools.name: get_headway
tools.description: Calculates the headway, which is the distance from the front of the ego vehicle to the closest leading object, using curvilinear coordinates. This function requires the ego vehicle's information, the detected lane, and the 3D bounding boxes from perception data.

bounding_boxes.description: List of 3D bounding boxes representing detected objects. Each bounding box should include dimensions and the object's position relative to the ego vehicle.

ego_info.description: Information about the ego vehicle, including its position and orientation.

orientation.description: Orientation of the ego vehicle in degrees.

position.description: Curvilinear coordinates of the ego vehicle, consisting of lateral and longitudinal positions.

lateral.description: Lateral position of the ego vehicle in meters.

longitudinal.description: Longitudinal position of the ego vehicle in meters.

lane_id.description: Unique identifier for the detected lane.

tools.name: get_time_headway
tools.description: Calculates the time headway (THW), which is the time it will take for the ego vehicle to reach the closest leading object in curvilinear coordinates. Inputs include the ego vehicle's information, the detected lane, and the 3D bounding boxes of the perceived objects.

accelerations.description: List of accelerations of the detected objects in meters per second squared (m/s^2).

bboxes.description: List of 3D bounding boxes representing perceived objects. Each bounding box is described by its position and size.

ego_info.description: Contains the ego vehicle's current position and velocity.

position.description: The vehicle's current position as a tuple of x, y, and z coordinates (meters).

velocity.description: The vehicle's current velocity in meters per second (m/s).

lane_info.description: Information about the detected lane, including its curvature and width.

curvature.description: The curvature of the lane at the ego vehicle's position (1/meters).

width.description: The width of the lane in meters (m).

velocities.description: List of velocities of the detected objects in meters per second (m/s).

tools.name: get_time_to_collision
tools.description: Calculates the time it will take for the ego vehicle to collide with the closest leading object in curvilinear coordinates, considering both vehicles' velocities and the leading object's acceleration.

ego_acceleration.description: The current acceleration of the ego vehicle in meters per second squared.

ego_velocity.description: The current velocity of the ego vehicle in meters per second.

initial_distance.description: The initial distance between the ego vehicle and the leading object in meters.

leading_object_acceleration.description: The current acceleration of the leading object in meters per second squared.

leading_object_velocity.description: The current velocity of the leading object in meters per second.

tools.name: duck_duck_go
tools.description: A simple wrapper function for the Duck Duck Go Search API. It takes a search query and returns a JSON array containing the search results, which may include answers to questions about current events, general information, and web links.

format.description: The desired response format. Options include 'json', 'xml', and 'plaintext'.

no_html.description: A flag indicating whether to strip HTML from the search results. Set to true to remove HTML.

no_redirect.description: A flag indicating whether to prevent redirection to an answer page. If set to true, the search will not redirect to an answer page if one is found.

query.description: The search query to look up. It should be a string representing the user's search input. For example, 'latest NASA news' or 'python programming'.

skip_disambiguation.description: When true, the search results will skip over disambiguation pages.

tools.name: search_engine.query
tools.description: Conducts a search based on the provided prompt and returns relevant real-time information, specific details, or general facts from various sources, including internet browsing and data from Google.

include_facts.description: Indicates whether to include factual information in the search results. Default is true.

prompt.description: The search query to be executed by the search engine. Example: 'latest scientific discoveries'.

since_year.description: Filter results to include only information published after the specified year. Default to the current year if not provided.

source.description: Preferred source for the search results, such as 'all', 'internet', or 'google'.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image based on a given text prompt. The function is versatile and can be used for various general purposes without specializing in any specific category.

color_mode.description: The color mode of the image.

height.description: The height of the generated image in pixels.

image_format.description: The file format for the output image.

prompt.description: The text prompt that describes the desired content of the image.

width.description: The width of the generated image in pixels.

tools.name: generate_human_image
tools.description: Generates a realistic image of a human based on the provided prompt, with options for creating images representing different age groups and genders.

image_quality.description: The desired quality of the generated image, affecting the level of detail and realism. Options include 'low', 'medium', and 'high'.

include_background.description: Determines whether a background should be included in the generated image.

output_format.description: Specifies the file format for the output image.

prompt.description: A descriptive text guiding the generation of the human image, such as 'a smiling girl with blue eyes' or 'an elderly man playing chess'.

tools.name: multilingual_llm
tools.description: Interact with a multilingual large language model (LLM) to generate text-based answers in various languages, excluding real-time data and information post-2022. Suitable for processing prompts in languages such as Hindi, Arabic, Marathi, etc.

language.description: The language of the input prompt.

max_length.description: The maximum length of the response in number of tokens (words or punctuation).

q.description: The prompt for the LLM, provided in a supported language other than English. The format should be plain text.

temperature.description: The creativity level of the response, ranging from 0.0 (deterministic) to 1.0 (more creative).

tools.name: english_llm
tools.description: This function provides interaction with an English large language model (LLM) to generate text-based answers. It operates exclusively on English language prompts and does not include real-time data or information post-2022.

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the response. One token roughly corresponds to one word.

q.description: The English language prompt for the LLM to process and generate a response.

tools.name: events_api.EventsApi.get_events
tools.description: Retrieves all available events for a given timeframe. It allows for different query options such as excluding events triggered before the timeframe or filtering for event updates only.

_from.description: Alternative to 'windowSize', defines the start of the timeframe in Unix timestamp format. The query spans the range ['from', 'to').

eventTypeFilters.description: Filters events by type. Acceptable values are 'INFO', 'WARN', and 'ERROR'.

excludeTriggeredBefore.description: Exclude events that were triggered before the requested timeframe. Useful for batch jobs that only care about new events. Defaults to 'false'.

filterEventUpdates.description: Filters results to event updates that occurred within the query timeframe. Defaults to 'false'.

includeAgentMonitoringIssues.description: Include Agent Monitoring Issues in the results. This parameter is deprecated. Defaults to 'false'.

includeKubernetesInfoEvents.description: Include Kubernetes Info Events in the results. This parameter is deprecated. Defaults to 'false'.

to.description: The end of the requested timeframe as a Unix timestamp. Defaults to the current service time if not provided.

windowSize.description: The size of the requested timeframe in milliseconds relative to 'to'. Defaults to 600000 milliseconds (10 minutes) if not provided.

tools.name: agent_monitoring_events
tools.description: Retrieves all agent monitoring events for the specified timeframe. It allows for querying historical events, with a recommendation to use a 'to' timestamp slightly in the past to account for eventual consistency delays in event updates.

_from.description: The start of the requested timeframe as a Unix timestamp. If not provided, defaults to 'to' minus 'windowSize'. Defines the timeframe in range ['from', 'to').

excludeTriggeredBefore.description: If set to true, excludes events that were triggered before the requested timeframe. This enables searching for new events that started within the given timeframe. Useful for batch jobs that operate on fixed intervals.

filterEventUpdates.description: If set to true, filters the results to event updates only, including an event only if its state changed within the query timeframe. Useful for batch jobs that need to track event state updates.

to.description: The end of the requested timeframe as a Unix timestamp. Defaults to the current service time if not provided.

tools.name: add_service_config

year.description: The year for which the host count is requested. Should be a four-digit number, such as 2023.

tools.name: create_website_alert_config
tools.description: Create a configuration for website alerting in the system, setting up conditions under which alerts are triggered.

alertChannelIds.description: A list of the IDs for alert channels where the alert notifications will be sent.

description.description: A brief description of the website alert configuration.

granularity.description: The evaluation granularity in minutes used for the detection of threshold violations.

name.description: Name for the website alert configuration.

rule.description: The type of rule for this alert configuration, such as 'response_time' or 'error_rate'.

severity.description: The severity level of the alert when triggered. Valid values are integers, typically ranging from 1 (lowest severity) to 10 (highest severity).

tagFilterExpression.description: A boolean expression of tag filters that define the scope of relevant website beacons.

threshold.description: The threshold value that, when exceeded, will trigger the alert.

timeThreshold.description: The time in minutes for which the threshold must be exceeded in order to trigger the alert.

triggering.description: A flag to indicate if an incident is also triggered when the alert is triggered.

websiteId.description: The unique identifier of the website for which the alert is being configured.

tools.name: groups_api.GroupsApi.create_group_mapping
tools.description: Creates a mapping between a group from an Identity Provider (IdP) such as LDAP, OIDC, or SAML, and an Instana group. Upon user login, if the IdP is configured and mappings are enabled, the provided key-value pairs from the IdP will be evaluated. If the key-value pairs match the mapping criteria, the user will be automatically assigned to the corresponding Instana group. Note that the 'id' field in the payload is ignored, as Instana will generate a new unique identifier for each mapping.

group_id.description: The unique identifier of the Instana group to which the mapping will be applied.

key.description: The attribute key received from the IdP to be used for mapping.

mapping_enabled.description: A flag indicating if the mapping should be enabled immediately upon creation.

value.description: The expected value for the specified key that will trigger the mapping to the Instana group.

tools.name: EventSettingsApi.create_website_alert_config
tools.description: This API endpoint creates a configuration for website alerts, allowing users to define the conditions under which an alert is triggered and optionally create an associated incident.

alertChannelIds.description: A list of unique identifiers for alert channels defined in Instana to which the alert notifications will be sent.

description.description: A brief description of the website alert configuration.

granularity.description: The evaluation granularity in minutes, defining the size of the tumbling window used for detection of threshold violations.

name.description: The name for the website alert configuration.

rule.description: The type of rule this alert configuration represents, such as 'traffic spike' or 'downtime'.

severity.description: The severity level of the alert when triggered. Can be either 5 for a Warning or 10 for Critical.

tagFilterExpression.description: A boolean expression of tag filters used to define the scope of relevant website beacons.

threshold.description: The value of the threshold this alert rule is evaluated against.

timeThreshold.description: The time period in minutes for which the threshold must be violated to trigger the alert.

triggering.description: A flag indicating whether an Incident is also triggered when the alert is triggered.

websiteId.description: The unique identifier of the website for which the alert configuration is created.

tools.name: events_api.EventsApi.agent_monitoring_events
tools.description: Retrieves all agent monitoring events within a specified timeframe. It allows for querying historical events and can filter events based on their state updates. Users can define the timeframe using 'to', 'from', and 'windowSize' parameters.

windowSize.description: The size of the requested timeframe in milliseconds, relative to the 'to' parameter. If neither 'windowSize' nor 'from' is provided, defaults to 600000 milliseconds (10 minutes).

tracking_info.description: Tracking information including courier and tracking number if available. If not provided, the default is null, indicating that tracking information is not yet available.

tools.name: create_a_docker_file

tools.name: analyse_repo_contents

directory_name.description: The name of the directory where the repository is located. This should be the root directory of the repository.

tools.name: searchCVE
tools.description: Builds and sends a GET request to retrieve a list of CVEs (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) based on specified criteria. Date and time strings should be formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM', for example, '2023-03-01 00:00'.

cpeName.description: CPE (Common Platform Enumeration) name to match against CVE applicability statements. Use 'cpe' prefix, supports partial matches.

cveId.description: Unique identifier for a CVE, formatted as a string.

cvssV2Metrics.description: CVSSv2 vector string to filter CVEs by their CVSSv2 metrics. Full or partial strings accepted. Incompatible with cvssV3Metrics parameter.

cvssV2Severity.description: Filter CVEs by CVSSv2 severity levels.

cvssV3Metrics.description: CVSSv3 vector string to filter CVEs by their CVSSv3 metrics. Full or partial strings accepted. Incompatible with cvssV2Metrics parameter.

cvssV3Severity.description: Filter CVEs by CVSSv3 severity levels.

cweId.description: Filter CVEs by CWE ID. Example: 'CWE-34'.

delay.description: Define a delay between requests in seconds. Must be greater than 0.6 seconds. Recommended: 6 seconds.

hasCertAlerts.description: Return CVEs containing a Technical Alert from US-CERT.

hasCertNotes.description: Return CVEs containing a Vulnerability Note from CERT/CC.

hasOval.description: Return CVEs containing OVAL information from MITRE.

isVulnerable.description: Return vulnerable CVEs associated with a specific CPE. Requires cpeName parameter.

key.description: API key for NVD access. Required. Recommended delay between requests: 6 seconds.

keywordExactMatch.description: Enforce exact match for keywordSearch. Requires keywordSearch.

keywordSearch.description: Search for CVEs with specific words or phrases in their description. Supports multiple keywords.

lastModEndDate.description: Filter CVEs modified before this date and time. Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'. Must be used in conjunction with lastModStartDate.

lastModStartDate.description: Filter CVEs modified after this date and time. Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'. Must be used in conjunction with lastModEndDate.

limit.description: Limit the number of search results. Range: 1 to 2000.

noRejected.description: Exclude rejected CVEs from the search results.

pubEndDate.description: Filter CVEs published before this date and time. Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'. Must be used in conjunction with pubStartDate.

pubStartDate.description: Filter CVEs published after this date and time. Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'. Must be used in conjunction with pubEndDate.

sourceIdentifier.description: Filter CVEs by their data source identifier.

verbose.description: Print the URL request for debugging purposes.

versionEnd.description: Filter CVEs by the end of a version range. Must be used with versionEndType and virtualMatchString.

versionEndType.description: Include or exclude the version specified in versionEnd. Must be used with versionEnd and virtualMatchString.

versionStart.description: Filter CVEs by the start of a version range. Must be used with versionStartType and virtualMatchString.

versionStartType.description: Include or exclude the version specified in versionStart. Must be used with versionStart and virtualMatchString.

virtualMatchString.description: Broad filter against CPE Match Criteria in CVE applicability statements.

tools.name: searchCPE

cpeMatchString.description: A partial CPE name to search for matching CPE names.

cpeNameId.description: UUID of the specific CPE record to return. If the UUID does not exist, the result will be empty. Example format: '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000'.

delay.description: Time in seconds to wait between requests. Must be greater than 0.6 seconds with an API key, otherwise set to 6 seconds.

key.description: An API key for the NVD database that enables a higher request rate. Example format: 'ABC123DEF456GHI789J0'.

keywordExactMatch.description: When true, searches for an exact match of a phrase or word in CPE titles and reference links. Must be used with 'keywordSearch'.

keywordSearch.description: A word or phrase to find in metadata titles or reference links. Spaces between words imply an AND condition.

lastModEndDate.description: The end date for filtering CPEs by last modification date, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD 00:00' UTC. Must be used with 'lastModStartDate'.

lastModStartDate.description: The start date for filtering CPEs by last modification date, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD 00:00' UTC. Must be used with 'lastModEndDate'.

limit.description: Limits the number of search results. Must be a positive integer.

verbose.description: Enables printing of the request URL for debugging purposes.
