timeout.description: The time in seconds to wait for the user to respond before timing out.

tools.name: get_n_day_weather_forecast
tools.description: Retrieves the weather forecast for a specified number of days for a given city. The forecast includes daily temperature predictions in either Celsius or Fahrenheit.

format.description: The temperature format for the weather forecast. This is auto computed based on the city location.

location.description: The name of the city for which the weather forecast is being requested, in the format of 'City, Country' (e.g., 'New York, USA').

num_days.description: The number of days for which the weather forecast is required. Must be a positive integer.

tools.name: submit_complaint
tools.description: Submit a complaint for a user who is experiencing issues with parcel delivery, such as non-delivery or incorrect data entry.

parcelTrackingId.description: The unique tracking number of the parcel in question.

statement.description: A detailed description of the issue from the user's perspective.

userMobileNumber.description: The user's mobile number, expected to be in the format +[country code][number] (e.g., +989123456789).

userName.description: The user's full name in Persian script.

tools.name: GET_COMPLAINT_STATE
tools.description: Retrieves the current state of a user's complaint using the complaint tracking ID.

complaintTrackingId.description: A unique identifier for the complaint, used to track the status of the complaint.

userMobileNumber.description: The mobile number of the user, formatted as a string without spaces or special characters (e.g., '1234567890').

tools.name: get_province_id
tools.description: Retrieve the unique identifier (ID) associated with a province name.

country_code.description: The ISO country code to ensure the province is identified within the correct country context. For example: 'TH' for Thailand.

province_name.description: The name of the province for which the ID is requested. For example: 'Bangkok', 'Chiang Mai', 'Chonburi'.

tools.name: metrics_api.MetricsApi.get_portfolio_metrics_since
tools.description: Retrieve historical metrics for the entire portfolio starting from a specified date. The date should be in the format of 'YYYYMMDD' (e.g., '20210101' for January 1st, 2021).

date.description: The start date to retrieve metrics from, formatted as 'YYYYMMDD'. For example, '20210101' represents January 1st, 2021.

tools.name: project_api.ProjectApi.clone_project
tools.description: Creates a duplicate of a specified project, including all its associated data and settings. The cloned project will have a new unique identifier but will inherit the properties and configurations of the original project.

include_data.description: Determines whether the data associated with the project should also be cloned.

new_project_name.description: The name for the new cloned project.

project_id.description: The unique identifier of the project to be cloned.

tools.name: translate_english_to_chinese
tools.description: Translates a given text from English to Chinese.

output_format.description: The desired output format for the translated text.

text.description: The English text to be translated into Chinese.

tools.name: issue_priorities_api.get_priorities
tools.description: Retrieve a list of all available issue priorities from Jira. User must have the necessary permissions to access this information.

include_inactive.description: A flag to include inactive priorities in the response.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project to fetch priorities from. It should be in the format of 'PRJ-123'.

tools.name: issue_resolutions_api.get_resolutions
tools.description: Retrieve a list of all possible issue resolution values from Jira. A user must have the appropriate permissions to access this list.

project_id.description: The unique identifier for the project for which issue resolutions are requested. The format should be a project key or project ID.

user_token.description: User authentication token required to verify permissions to access issue resolutions in Jira.

tools.name: TimeTrackingApi.get_available_time_tracking_implementations
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all available time tracking providers. By default, Jira offers 'JIRA provided time tracking', but additional time tracking providers can be installed from the Atlassian Marketplace. For more information, refer to the Time Tracking Provider module documentation. To use this function, the user must have the 'Administer Jira' global permission.

tools.name: server_info_api.ServerInfoApi.get_server_info
tools.description: Retrieves details about the Jira instance, including the version number, deployment type, and build information. This method is accessible without authentication.

tools.name: issue_fields_api.IssueFieldsApi.get_fields_paginated
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of fields for Classic Jira projects. Allows retrieval of all fields, specific fields by ID, or fields containing a particular string in their name or description. Custom fields are queried by setting the 'type' to 'custom'. Administer Jira global permission is required.

expand.description: Include additional information in the response. Accepts a comma-separated list of options such as 'key', 'lastUsed', 'screensCount', 'contextsCount', 'isLocked', 'searcherKey'.

id.description: The IDs of the custom fields to return or filter by when 'query' is specified.

maxResults.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

orderBy.description: Order the results by a specified field. Possible values include 'contextsCount', 'lastUsed', 'name', 'screensCount'.

query.description: String used to perform a case-insensitive partial match with field names or descriptions.

startAt.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).

type.description: The type of fields to search, set to 'custom' for custom fields.

tools.name: getClothes
tools.description: Provides a list of recommended clothing items based on the current temperature.

clothing_type.description: The type of clothing to filter recommendations, such as 'outerwear', 'footwear', etc.

temperature.description: The current temperature in degrees Celsius, for which clothing recommendations will be provided.

tools.name: getTemperature
tools.description: Retrieve the current temperature for a specified city. The temperature is provided in degrees Celsius.

city_name.description: The unique identifier of a city in the format of 'country_code/city_name', such as 'cn/hefei' or 'us/la'.

tools.name: getCity
tools.description: Retrieves the abbreviated form of a city's name based on the full name provided. For example, providing 'China/Hefei' would return 'cn/hf', and 'United States/Los Angeles' would return 'us/la'.

whole_name.description: The complete name of the city to be abbreviated, in the format 'Country/City', such as 'China/Hefei' or 'Ireland/Galway'.

tools.name: vt_get_domain_report
tools.description: Retrieves a report for a specified domain from the VirusTotal database, including categorized URLs, samples, and undetected files associated with the domain.

domain.description: The domain name for which the report is requested, in the format 'example.com'.

x_apikey.description: The API key used to authenticate the request to the VirusTotal service.

tools.name: vt_get_ip_address_report
tools.description: Retrieves a security report for a specified IP address from the VirusTotal database using the API.

ip.description: The IPv4 address for which the report is to be retrieved, in standard dot notation (e.g., '192.168.1.1').

x_apikey.description: The API key used for authentication with the VirusTotal service.

tools.name: vt_add_comment_to_ip_address
tools.description: Adds a user-provided comment to a specified IP address within the VirusTotal database using the provided API key.

data.description: The content of the comment to be added to the IP address.

ip.description: The IP address to which the comment will be added. Format: IPv4 or IPv6.

x_apikey.description: The API key used for authenticating the request to the VirusTotal API.

tools.name: vt_get_comments_on_domain
tools.description: Retrieves comments posted about a specific internet domain from the VirusTotal database.

cursor.description: A pagination cursor that points to the start of the subset of the result set that should be returned. Use the value returned in the 'next' field in the previous response to continue from where you stopped.

domain.description: The domain name for which comments should be retrieved. For example, 'example.com'.

limit.description: The maximum number of comments to retrieve. Must be a positive integer.

x_apikey.description: The API key used for authenticating with the VirusTotal API.

tools.name: vt_get_objects_related_to_domain
tools.description: Retrieves objects related to a specified domain by a given relationship type, with optional pagination through a cursor and a limit on the number of results.

cursor.description: Cursor token for pagination. Used to retrieve the next set of results in the sequence.

domain.description: The target domain for which related objects are to be retrieved.

limit.description: The maximum number of related objects to return. A positive integer up to a certain limit (e.g., 100).

relationship.description: The type of relationship based on which related objects are retrieved, such as 'subdomains' or 'resolutions'.

x_apikey.description: API key for authentication with the service.

tools.name: vt_get_object_descriptors_related_to_domain
tools.description: Retrieve a list of object descriptors that are related to a specified domain, filtered by the specified relationship type.

cursor.description: A cursor used for pagination, which points to the start of the next set of results. If omitted, the first page of results is returned.

domain.description: The internet domain name for which related object descriptors are being queried, such as 'example.com'.

limit.description: The maximum number of descriptors to return in the response. The value must be between 1 and 100.

relationship.description: The type of relationship between the domain and the descriptors.

x_apikey.description: The API key used for authenticating with the service. If not provided, a default public key is used.

tools.name: vt_get_dns_resolution_object
tools.description: Retrieves the DNS resolution details for a given domain or IP address from the VirusTotal API.

id.description: The unique identifier for the domain or IP address whose DNS resolution details are to be retrieved.

x_apikey.description: The API key used to authenticate with the VirusTotal service. This should be kept confidential.

tools.name: vt_get_comments_on_ip_address
tools.description: Retrieves comments posted on a specific IP address from VirusTotal's database.

cursor.description: A pointer to the next set of results for pagination purposes. If not provided, it starts from the beginning.

ip.description: The IP address for which to retrieve comments, in IPv4 (e.g., '192.168.1.1') or IPv6 (e.g., '2001:0db8:85a3:0000:0000:8a2e:0370:7334') format.

limit.description: The maximum number of comments to retrieve. The value must be between 1 and 100.

x_apikey.description: The API key used for authenticating with the VirusTotal API. This should be kept confidential.

tools.name: vt_get_objects_related_to_ip_address
tools.description: Retrieves objects related to a given IP address, such as associated domains, URLs, or files, based on the specified relationship type.

cursor.description: A cursor used to navigate through multiple pages of results. If not provided, the first page of results will be returned.

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address for which related objects are to be retrieved.

limit.description: The maximum number of related objects to return.

relationship.description: The type of relationship to look for between the IP address and other objects.

x_apikey.description: The API key used for authentication with the service.

tools.name: vt_get_object_descriptors_related_to_ip_address
tools.description: Retrieve descriptors for objects related to a given IP address, such as associated URLs, files, or domains. The descriptors provide detailed information about the relationships and can be used for further analysis.

cursor.description: A pagination cursor that points to the starting position of the result set to fetch.

ip.description: The IP address for which related object descriptors are to be retrieved.

limit.description: The maximum number of object descriptors to retrieve.

relationship.description: The type of relationship to filter the object descriptors by.

x_apikey.description: The API key used for authentication to access the service.

tools.name: vt_get_votes_on_ip_address
tools.description: Retrieves the voting information associated with a specific IP address from the VirusTotal database.

ip.description: The IP address for which voting information is to be retrieved, in IPv4 or IPv6 format.

tools.name: vt_add_votes_to_ip_address
tools.description: Adds votes to an IP address in the system using a given API key for authentication.

data.description: The vote data being submitted, as a JSON-formatted string containing the vote details.

ip.description: The IP address to which the votes will be added, in IPv4 or IPv6 format.

x_apikey.description: The API key used for authenticating the request.

tools.name: TimeTrackingApi.select_time_tracking_implementation
tools.description: Selects a time tracking provider for the system. Administer Jira global permission is required to perform this operation.

configuration.description: Configuration details for the provider in JSON format. Optional and provider-dependent.

enable.description: Flag to enable or disable the selected time tracking provider. Defaults to true if not specified.

provider_id.description: Unique identifier for the time tracking provider.

tools.name: get_available_time_tracking_implementations
tools.description: Retrieve a list of all time tracking providers available in Jira. By default, Jira includes the 'JIRA provided time tracking' provider. Additional time tracking providers can be added through apps from the Atlassian Marketplace. For further details, refer to the Time Tracking Provider module documentation. Administer Jira global permission is required to access this information.

tools.name: get_selected_time_tracking_implementation
tools.description: Retrieves the currently selected time tracking provider. If time tracking is disabled, an empty response is returned. Requires 'Administer Jira' global permission.

tools.name: audit_records_api.AuditRecordsApi.get_audit_records
tools.description: Retrieves a list of audit records, which can be filtered by matching against specific audit fields or by creation date. Requires 'Administer Jira' global permission.

_from.description: The start date and time for filtering audit records, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z'). If 'to' is provided, 'from' must be earlier, or no records are returned.

filter.description: A space-separated string to match with audit field content. Filters results to include items where each item has at least one match in fields like 'summary', 'category', 'eventSource', etc.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return, to limit the size of the returned list.

offset.description: The number of records to skip before returning the first result.

to.description: The end date and time for filtering audit records, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-31T23:59:59Z'). If 'from' is provided, 'to' must be later, or no records are returned.

tools.name: TimeTrackingApi.get_shared_time_tracking_configuration
tools.description: Retrieves the configuration settings for time tracking, which includes the time format, default time unit, and additional settings. To administer these settings, 'Administer Jira' global permission is required. For more details, refer to the [Configuring time tracking](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/qoXKM) documentation.

include_inactive.description: Specifies whether to include settings for inactive projects in the results. By default, only active projects are included.

project_id.description: The ID of the project for which time tracking settings are being retrieved. The format should be a string of alphanumeric characters, such as 'PRJ123'.

tools.name: call_uber
tools.description: Requests an Uber ride to the specified pickup location.

location.description: The address, city, or ZIP code of the pickup location, formatted as 'Street Address, City, State, ZIP Code' (e.g., '123 Main St, Springfield, IL, 62701').

passenger_count.description: The number of passengers for the ride.

payment_method.description: The preferred payment method for the ride (e.g., 'Credit Card', 'Uber Credits', 'PayPal').

promo_code.description: A valid promotional code for discounts on the ride, if applicable.

ride_type.description: The type of Uber ride to request.

tools.name: license_api.LicenseApi.get_license
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific software license using its SPDX License ID.

licenseId.description: The unique identifier for the license, adhering to the SPDX specification.

tools.name: ldap_api.LdapApi.retrieve_ldap_groups
tools.description: Performs a pass-through query to the configured LDAP server to retrieve the distinguished names (DNs) of all accessible groups. The search results are cached according to the default Alpine CacheManager policy.

cache_policy.description: The caching policy to use for the search results. Default policies could be 'default', 'never', 'always', or 'if_remote'.

return_attributes.description: A list of attributes to return. For example, ['cn', 'member'].

search_base.description: The base DN from which the search should start. For example, 'dc=example,dc=com'.

search_filter.description: The search filter to apply. For instance, '(objectClass=group)'.

search_scope.description: The scope of the search. Possible values include 'base', 'onelevel', and 'subtree'.

size_limit.description: The maximum number of entries to return. A value of 0 indicates no limit.

time_limit.description: Time limit in seconds for the search query. A value of 0 means no limit.

tools.name: LicenseApi.delete_license
tools.description: Removes a specified custom license from the system using its unique SPDX License ID.

licenseId.description: The unique identifier for the license, conforming to the SPDX License ID format, such as 'MIT' or 'GPL-3.0'.

tools.name: license_group_api.LicenseGroupApi.add_license_to_license_group
tools.description: This function adds a specified license identified by its UUID to an existing license group, also identified by a UUID.

licenseUuid.description: The UUID of the license to be added to the license group.

uuid.description: The UUID of the license group to which the license will be added.

tools.name: license_group_api.LicenseGroupApi.get_license_group
tools.description: Retrieve the details of a specific license group using its universally unique identifier (UUID).

uuid.description: The unique identifier of the license group to retrieve. It must follow the standard UUID format.

tools.name: service_api.ServiceApi.create_service
tools.description: Creates a new service instance with a unique identifier.

uuid.description: The unique identifier for the new service. It should be a valid UUID format string.

tools.name: team_api.TeamApi.create_team
tools.description: Creates a new team in the system and generates an associated API key for team operations.

team_description.description: A brief description of the team and its purpose.

team_name.description: The name of the new team to be created.

team_owner_email.description: The email address of the team's owner.

tools.name: project_api.ProjectApi.create_project
tools.description: Creates a new project within the system. If the project is a subproject, the UUID of the parent project must be provided.

description.description: A brief description of the project.

end_date.description: The anticipated end date for the project in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'.

name.description: The name of the new project.

parent_project_uuid.description: The UUID of the parent project if this is a subproject, otherwise it can be omitted.

start_date.description: The start date for the project in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-01-01'.

status.description: The current status of the project.

tools.name: service_api.ServiceApi.get_all_services
tools.description: This function retrieves a list of all services associated with a specific project identified by a universally unique identifier (UUID).

uuid.description: The unique identifier for the project in the format of a UUID string (e.g., '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000').

tools.name: team_api.TeamApi.delete_api_key
tools.description: This function deletes a specified API key from the team's account, removing its access to the API.

apikey.description: The unique identifier for the API key that needs to be deleted.

tools.name: releases_api.ReleasesApi.get_all_releases
tools.description: Retrieve a list of releases with optional filters such as name, start time, and date range. The endpoint can be used to create, update, delete, and fetch details for existing releases.

_from.description: Filter to include only releases with a start time greater than or equal to this UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

maxResults.description: The maximum number of releases to retrieve. Use a positive integer to limit results.

name.description: The exact name of the release to retrieve, e.g., 'Release-161'.

releaseId.description: A unique identifier for each release.

start.description: The start time of the release, represented as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

to.description: Filter to include only releases with a start time less than or equal to this UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

tools.name: update_website_alert_config
tools.description: Updates the configuration for website alerts, including severity, triggering incidents, and scope of relevant website beacons.

alertChannelIds.description: A list of unique identifiers for alert channels where notifications will be sent, such as email or SMS channel IDs.

description.description: A brief description of the website alert configuration.

granularity.description: The evaluation granularity in minutes used for detection of threshold violations. For example, a granularity of 1 means the alert system checks every minute.

id.description: The unique identifier of the website alert configuration to be updated.

name.description: The name assigned to the website alert configuration.

rule.description: The type of rule applied in this alert configuration.

severity.description: The severity level of the alert when triggered. Values typically range from 1 (lowest severity) to 10 (highest severity).

tagFilterExpression.description: A boolean expression defining the scope of website beacons to be monitored, based on tags.

threshold.description: The threshold value that, when exceeded, triggers the alert. For example, a threshold of 90.0 could represent 90% CPU usage.

timeThreshold.description: The time in minutes that the defined threshold must be exceeded to trigger the alert. A value of 5 means the threshold must be exceeded for 5 consecutive minutes.

triggering.description: A flag to determine whether an incident is triggered when the alert is activated.

websiteId.description: The unique identifier of the website associated with this alert configuration.

tools.name: EventSettingsApi.get_custom_event_specifications
tools.description: Retrieve a list of all custom event specifications defined within the system.

tools.name: EventSettingsApi.get_event_specification_infos
tools.description: Retrieves a summary of all built-in and custom event specifications within the system.

tools.name: team_api.TeamApi.delete_team
tools.description: Deletes the specified team from the system. The operation cannot be undone once completed.

confirm.description: A flag that must be set to true to confirm the deletion of the team. This acts as a safeguard against accidental deletions.

team_id.description: The unique identifier of the team to be deleted.

tools.name: user_api.UserApi.delete_ldap_user
tools.description: Deletes an LDAP user from the system by their unique user ID.

confirm.description: A flag to confirm the deletion of the user. Must be set to true to proceed with deletion.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the LDAP user to be deleted.

tools.name: user_api.delete_managed_user
tools.description: This function permanently removes a user from the system. It requires the user's unique identifier to execute.

confirmation.description: A flag to confirm the deletion operation. Must be set to true to proceed.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user to be deleted.

tools.name: user_api.UserApi.remove_team_from_user
tools.description: This function removes a specified user from a team, effectively revoking their team-related privileges.

team_id.description: The unique identifier of the team from which the user will be removed.

username.description: The unique identifier of the user to be removed from the team.

tools.name: permission_api.PermissionApi.remove_permission_from_user
tools.description: Removes a specified permission from a user account. This action ensures that the user will no longer have the rights associated with the removed permission.

permission.description: The specific permission to be removed from the user account. For example, it can be 'read', 'write', 'delete', etc.

username.description: The unique identifier of the user account from which the permission will be removed. The username should be in the format of a valid email address, such as 'user@example.com'.

tools.name: user_api.UserApi.delete_managed_user
tools.description: Permanently removes a user account and its associated data from the system.

confirmation.description: A flag to confirm the deletion. Must be set to true to proceed with the deletion.

reason.description: The reason for deleting the user's account.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user to be deleted.

tools.name: search_api.SearchApi.component_search
tools.description: Performs a search based on the provided query and returns relevant results.

query.description: The search term used to find relevant components. It should be a concise string representing the search criteria.

tools.name: search_api.SearchApi.service_search
tools.description: This endpoint processes the provided search query and returns relevant search results.

query.description: The search term used to query the service for relevant results.

tools.name: search_api.SearchApi.vulnerability_search
tools.description: Executes a search for vulnerabilities based on the provided query parameters and returns the results.

query.description: The search term used to query the database for vulnerabilities. It supports advanced search syntax for detailed queries.

tools.name: oidc_api.OidcApi.update_group
tools.description: Updates the properties of an existing group identified by its unique ID, with the provided details.

group_details.description: The details of the group to be updated.

active.description: Indicates whether the group is active or not.

description.description: A brief summary about the purpose or role of the group.

name.description: The new name of the group.

group_id.description: The unique identifier for the group to be updated.

tools.name: ecosystem_api.EcosystemApi.get_inactive_ecosystems
tools.description: Retrieve a list of inactive ecosystems from the Open Source Vulnerabilities (OSV) database that a user can select.

tools.name: team_api.delete_team
tools.description: Deletes the specified team from the system. This action is irreversible.

confirm.description: A confirmation flag to ensure intentional deletion.

team_id.description: The unique identifier of the team to be deleted.

tools.name: oidc_api.update_group
tools.description: Updates the properties of an existing group in the OpenID Connect (OIDC) system.

group_details.description: The details of the group to update.

active.description: A flag indicating if the group is active or not.

description.description: A brief description of the group and its purpose.

name.description: The new name for the group.

group_id.description: The unique identifier of the group to be updated.

tools.name: TeamApi.get_self
tools.description: Retrieve details of the team associated with the authenticated user.

tools.name: oidc_api.OidcApi.add_mapping_2
tools.description: Adds a new OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider to client mapping. This allows the specified client to use the given OIDC provider for authentication.

client_id.description: The client identifier for which the mapping is to be added.

client_secret.description: The client secret corresponding to the client identifier. This is an optional parameter.

grant_types.description: A list of grant types permitted for the OIDC client, such as 'authorization_code' and 'implicit'.

provider_id.description: The unique identifier of the OIDC provider.

redirect_uris.description: A list of allowed redirect URIs for the OIDC client. Each URI should be a well-formed URL.

response_types.description: A list of response types permitted for the OIDC client, such as 'code' or 'token'.

scope.description: The default scope to be requested from the OIDC provider. Typically includes 'openid'.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: The authentication method to be used at the token endpoint of the OIDC provider. This should match one of the allowed methods supported by the provider.

tools.name: ldap_api.LdapApi.add_mapping_1
tools.description: Adds a new LDAP mapping to the system, linking LDAP groups to system roles.

description.description: An optional description of the mapping for reference.

ldap_group.description: The name of the LDAP group to be mapped.

system_role.description: The corresponding system role to which the LDAP group will be mapped.

tools.name: user_api.UserApi.create_managed_user
tools.description: Creates a new managed user in the system with specified attributes.

email.description: The email address for the new user.

full_name.description: The full name of the user.

is_active.description: Indicates whether the user account is active.

password.description: The password for the new user account.

role.description: The role assigned to the user.

username.description: The unique username for the new user.

tools.name: oidc_api.add_mapping_2
tools.description: Adds a mapping between an OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider and the client system to enable authentication.

client_id.description: The client identifier issued to the client during the registration process.

client_secret.description: The client secret. It should be kept confidential.

grant_types.description: A list of grant types that the client can use. Examples include 'authorization_code' and 'implicit'.

provider_id.description: The unique identifier of the OIDC provider.

redirect_uris.description: A list of allowed redirect URIs for the client.

response_types.description: A list of the OAuth 2.0 response types that the client can use. Typically includes 'code' for authorization code flow.

scope.description: A space-delimited list of scopes that the client can request during authentication. Example: 'openid profile email'.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: The requested authentication method for the token endpoint. This method should match one of the client's registered authentication methods.

tools.name: user_api.UserApi.add_team_to_user
tools.description: Associates a user with a specified team, allowing them access to team resources.

team_id.description: The unique identifier of the team to which the user will be added.

username.description: The unique identifier of the user to be added to the team.

tools.name: cwe_api.CweApi.get_cwe
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) based on its unique identifier.

cwe_id.description: The unique integer identifier of the Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) to retrieve. For example, for 'CWE-79', the cwe_id would be 79.

tools.name: component_api.ComponentApi.get_component_by_hash
tools.description: Retrieves a list of components from the database that match the specified cryptographic hash value.

hash.description: A cryptographic hash of the component to retrieve. This can be in the format of MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA3-256, SHA3-384, SHA3-512, BLAKE2b-256, BLAKE2b-384, BLAKE2b-512, or BLAKE3.

tools.name: search_api.SearchApi.vulnerable_software_search
tools.description: Search for software vulnerabilities using a query string or a Common Platform Enumeration (CPE) identifier. The search results will include relevant software that is known to be vulnerable.

cpe.description: The CPE identifier to specify the software product and version for a more precise search.

query.description: The search query string to find vulnerabilities. It can include software names, versions, or any relevant keywords.

tools.name: search_api.SearchApi.project_search
tools.description: Executes a search operation and returns results based on the provided query.

query.description: The search query string specifying the criteria used for finding projects.

tools.name: get_promotions
tools.description: Retrieve the current promotions available for customers. This function filters promotions based on the provided criteria.

active_only.description: A flag to determine if only active promotions should be returned. Set to true to receive only currently active promotions.

category.description: The category of products for which to find promotions. For example, 'electronics', 'books', 'clothing', etc.

end_date.description: The end date until which to search for promotions, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD' (e.g., '2023-12-31'). If not provided, it assumes no end date restriction.

max_discount.description: The maximum discount percentage to filter the promotions. For example, set to 0.50 for promotions with up to 50% off.

start_date.description: The start date from which to begin searching for promotions, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD' (e.g., '2023-01-01'). If not provided, defaults to the current date.

tools.name: get_customer_bookings
tools.description: Retrieve a list of customer bookings with optional filters for latest, professional-only, and specific date bookings.

is_latest_booking.description: Flag to filter for the latest booking of the customer. False (0) does not require, True (1) is required.

is_no_datetime_booking.description: Flag to filter for bookings that do not have an appointment date set. False (0) does not require, True (1) is required.

is_no_professional_booking.description: Flag to filter out bookings that are not taken by service providers. False (0) does not require, True (1) is required.

service_date.description: The service appointment date of customer bookings, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

tools.name: get_skin_color
tools.description: Retrieves the specified skin color value. If the skin color is not specified, an error is raised.

skin_color.description: The specified skin color to retrieve. Must be a known color name.

tools.name: __get_all_user_list
tools.description: Retrieve a list containing the names of all users in the system.

include_inactive.description: Whether to include inactive users in the list. If false, only active users are listed.

sort_order.description: The order in which the user names should be sorted.

tools.name: __query_meeting_room_list
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all meeting rooms including their names and capacities.

tools.name: __get_meeting_room_schedule
tools.description: Retrieve the booking details of specified meeting rooms within a given start and end time.

end_time.description: The end time for the schedule query in ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2020-01-01T18:15:30+08:00'.

room_names.description: A list of meeting room names to check the schedule for, such as ['Room A', 'Room B'].

start_time.description: The start time for the schedule query in ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2020-01-01T10:15:30+08:00'.

tools.name: __book_meeting_room
tools.description: Reserves a meeting room by specifying the room name and the start and end times. It also registers a list of attendees.

attendees.description: A list of attendees' names for the meeting, such as ['User1', 'User2'].

end_time.description: The end time of the meeting in ISO 8601 format, for example '2020-01-01T10:15:30+08:00'.

meeting_room_name.description: The full name of the meeting room to be reserved.

start_time.description: The start time of the meeting in ISO 8601 format, for example '2020-01-01T10:15:30+08:00'.

tools.name: search_local_docs
tools.description: Searches the local knowledge base for documents that match the given natural language query and returns relevant document entries.

include_metadata.description: Determines whether to include metadata for the documents in the search results.

limit.description: The maximum number of documents to return.

query.description: The search query expressed in natural language, such as 'What are the symptoms of a cold?'.

tools.name: get_city_name
tools.description: Retrieves the full standardized name of a city based on input that includes the city and state abbreviation, formatted as 'City, State'.

city_name.description: The full name of the city along with the state abbreviation, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA'.

unit.description: The measurement unit for the geographical data associated with the city name. This parameter is optional and is intended for future extensibility.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Retrieves the current weather for a specified city and state.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA'.

unit.description: The unit of temperature for the weather report.

tools.name: get_value_chat
tools.description: Retrieves a chat value based on the service ID, work hours, and service date. It indicates whether the service is scheduled for tomorrow.

is_tomorrow.description: A flag indicating whether the service is scheduled for tomorrow. True if the service is tomorrow, false otherwise.

service_date.description: The date of the customer's service appointment, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to null, which represents the current date.

service_id.description: The unique identifier of the service. Valid values are 1 for cleaning service, 2 for ironing service, 3 for massage, 13 for big cleaning service, 39 for bathroom cleaning, 15 for dust mites cleaning, 35 for cleaning services for a team of 3 people, and 24 for disinfectant cleaning.

work_hours.description: The number of hours booked for the service.

tools.name: contains_word_gaurav
tools.description: Check whether the given text contains the keyword 'gaurav'.

keyword.description: The word to be checked within the text. The function verifies if this keyword is present.

tools.name: policy_api.update_policy
tools.description: Updates the attributes of an existing policy with new values as specified in the request.

policy_data.description: The data containing the new values for the policy attributes.

active.description: The status of the policy, where 'true' means active and 'false' means inactive.

description.description: A brief description of the policy.

name.description: The name of the policy.

policy_id.description: The unique identifier of the policy to be updated.

tools.name: analysis_api.AnalysisApi.update_analysis
tools.description: This method updates the analysis record with the decision made during the analysis process. It is used to capture and store the outcome of an analysis for future reference.

analysis_id.description: The unique identifier of the analysis record to be updated.

decision.description: The decision made during the analysis process.

decision_date.description: The date and time when the decision was made, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.

decision_reason.description: A brief description of the reason behind the decision made.

tools.name: policy_api.PolicyApi.create_policy
tools.description: This method creates a new policy on the server with the provided policy details.

coverage_amount.description: The total coverage amount for the policy in USD.

customer_id.description: The identifier of the customer purchasing the policy.

effective_date.description: The start date of the policy coverage, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Defaults to the current date if not provided.

policy_name.description: The unique name for the policy.

policy_type.description: The type of policy to be created.

terms.default: Standard terms apply. Please review the policy details thoroughly.
terms.description: The terms and conditions text for the policy.

tools.name: helpDocSearchFunc
tools.description: Retrieves help documentation for Webex collaboration products from the online help site based on the user's search query.

language.description: The language preference for the help documentation.

maxResults.description: The maximum number of help documents to return in the search results. Defaults to 10.

query.description: The search keyword or phrase for querying the help documents, such as 'video conference setup' or 'account management'.

tools.name: getMeetingTranscriptFunc
tools.description: Retrieves the transcript of a meeting including details such as topics, agendas, and discussions. If a duration is not specified, the transcript for the last 10 minutes will be fetched.

lastDurationInSeconds.description: The duration for which the transcript is requested, in seconds. If not specified, defaults to the last 600 seconds (10 minutes).

meetingID.description: The unique identifier for the meeting whose transcript is being requested.

tools.name: awx_list_job_templates
tools.description: List all available job templates in AWX, providing options to filter results based on criteria such as name, project, and inventory.

inventory_id.description: Filter job templates by their associated inventory ID.

page.description: The page number to retrieve in the paginated result set.

page_size.description: The number of job template records to display per page.

project_id.description: Filter job templates by their associated project ID.

search.description: A search term to filter job templates by name.

tools.name: awx_run_job_templates
tools.description: Executes specified job templates in AWX (Ansible Tower), facilitating automated job execution and management.

extra_vars.description: Additional variables to pass to the job template in JSON format.

inventory.description: The ID of the inventory to be used with the job template.

job_type.description: The type of job to be executed.

limit.description: A string that identifies which hosts should be managed. Could be a single host, a group, or a comma-separated list of hosts or groups.

skip_tags.description: Tags to skip during the job template execution, useful for bypassing certain tasks within the playbook.

tags.description: Specific tags to use for the job template execution, allowing to target specific tasks within the playbook.

template_id.description: The unique identifier of the template that is going to be run.

verbosity.description: The level of output verbosity for the job execution. Ranges from 0 (normal) to 5 (highest level of verbosity).

tools.name: awx_create_job_templates
tools.description: Creates a job template in Ansible AWX, which includes essential details like the project, playbook, inventory, and credentials needed for automation jobs.

credential_id.description: The unique identifier of the credentials to be used by the job template for access to nodes.

inventory_id.description: The unique identifier of the inventory to be used by the job template.

job_type.description: Specifies the type of job the template should run; either executing commands ('run') or just checking for potential changes ('check').

name.description: The unique name for the job template being created.

playbook.description: The name of the playbook file within the project to be executed by the job template.

project_id.description: The unique identifier of the project to be used by the job template.

tools.name: respond
tools.description: Generates a response message based on the provided input.

location.description: The geographical location for which the response is tailored, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'New York, NY'.

message.description: The message to be included in the response.

tools.name: get_event_specification_infos
tools.description: Retrieves a summary of all built-in and custom event specifications within the system.

include_built_in.description: Flag to determine whether to include built-in event specifications in the summary.

include_custom.description: Flag to determine whether to include custom event specifications in the summary.

tools.name: EventSettingsApi.get_system_rules
tools.description: Retrieve a list of all the system-defined rules for custom event specifications, which can be used to configure and manage custom events within the system.

active_only.description: A flag indicating whether to return only active rules. If true, only rules that are currently active will be returned.

event_category.description: The category of the event for which the system rules are requested. For example, 'security' or 'system'.

tools.name: get_event_specification_infos_by_ids
tools.description: Retrieves a summary of all built-in and custom event specifications using their unique identifiers.

event_ids.description: A list of unique identifiers for the event specifications to be retrieved.

include_details.description: Flag to determine whether to include detailed information for each event specification.

tools.name: get_custom_event_specifications
tools.description: Retrieve a list of all custom event specifications defined within the system.

limit.description: The maximum number of custom event specifications to return at once.

offset.description: The offset from the start of the list for pagination purposes.

search_term.description: A search term to filter the custom event specifications by name or description.

sort_order.description: The order in which the list of custom event specifications should be sorted.

tools.name: uber.eat.reviews
tools.description: Submit a review for a food item ordered through Uber Eats, including textual feedback and a star rating.

reviews.description: Textual feedback on the food item. Optional and can be left empty if no comments.

star_rating.description: The star rating for the food item, on a scale from 1 to 5.

tools.name: enable_infra_alert_config
tools.description: Enables the specified infrastructure alert configuration, allowing alerts to be triggered based on the defined criteria.

id.description: The unique identifier of the infrastructure alert configuration to be enabled.

tools.name: find_infra_alert_config
tools.description: Retrieve an infrastructure alert configuration by its ID. This includes both active and previously deleted configurations.

id.description: The unique identifier of the infrastructure alert configuration.

validOn.description: The timestamp representing the date and time to check the validity of the alert configuration. Expects a Unix timestamp in seconds.

tools.name: EventSettingsApi.enable_custom_event_specification
tools.description: Enable a previously defined custom event specification to start tracking the specified events.

eventSpecificationId.description: Unique identifier of the custom event specification to be enabled.

tools.name: EventSettingsApi.get_built_in_event_specification
tools.description: Retrieve the details of a built-in event specification using its unique identifier.

eventSpecificationId.description: The unique identifier of the built-in event specification to retrieve.

tools.name: repair_mobile
tools.description: Send the mobile device to the selected repair shop for servicing or fixing any issues.

issue_description.description: A brief description of the issues with the phone.

shop.description: The name of the repair shop where the phone will be taken for repair. Example: 'TechFix Center'.

urgent.description: Whether the repair needs to be done urgently. Defaults to false.

tools.name: clean
tools.description: Perform data cleaning on the provided dataset by removing null values, duplicates, and applying normalization.

df.description: The dataset in the form of a dataframe to be cleaned.

normalize_columns.description: Flag to determine whether to normalize numerical columns.

remove_duplicates.description: Flag to determine whether to remove duplicate rows.

remove_nulls.description: Flag to determine whether to remove rows with null values.

tools.name: order_food
tools.description: Places an order for food on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant, items, and their quantities.

items.description: A list of names of selected items to order.

quantities.description: An array of integers representing the quantity for each selected item, corresponding by index to the 'items' array.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

tools.name: summary_stat_explainer
tools.description: Provides an explanation of the summary statistics for a given dataset, helping users to understand measures such as mean, median, mode, variance, and standard deviation.

confidence_level.description: The confidence level to use when calculating confidence intervals for the summary statistics, expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1.

file_path.description: The file path to the summary statistics file. The file should be in CSV or JSON format.

include_graphs.description: Whether to include graphical representations of the summary statistics such as histograms and box plots.

tools.name: request_ride
tools.description: Initiates a ride-sharing service request from a specific departure point to a designated destination.

departure.description: The departure location in the format of 'Address' or 'Latitude, Longitude'. For example, '123 Main St, Anytown, CA' or '37.7749, -122.4194'.

destination.description: The destination location in the format of 'Address' or 'Latitude, Longitude'. For example, '456 Elm St, Othertown, CA' or '37.8715, -122.2730'.

ride_type.description: The service level of the ride to be requested.

tools.name: translate_text
tools.description: Translates a given text from one language to another using ISO 639-1 language codes for source and target languages.

source_language.description: The ISO 639-1 language code of the source text (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish).

source_text.description: The text to be translated. It should not exceed 5000 characters.

target_language.description: The ISO 639-1 language code of the target language into which the text will be translated (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish).

translation_mode.description: The mode of translation, indicating the desired level of formality.

tools.name: get_xvg_products
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all xVG product names available in the system.

api_version.description: The version of the API to use, formatted as 'v1', 'v2', etc.

category.description: The category of xVG products to filter by.

include_discontinued.description: Whether to include discontinued xVG products in the list.

sort_order.description: The order in which to sort the product names.

tools.name: get_business_units
tools.description: Retrieve a list of business unit identifiers and their corresponding names for all business units.

tools.name: get.BU_products
tools.description: Retrieve business unit-specific product information for use in the SLA Dashboard and Patch Self Service interfaces.

anchor.description: Specifies whether to retrieve all products, only user-specific products, or only anchor products.

tools.name: get_sla_products
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all products that have Service Level Agreement (SLA) metrics associated with them.

anchor.description: Filter to indicate if products are considered 'anchor' products, related to a specific user, or include all products. Possible values are 'all' for all products, 'user' for products related to the user, or 'anchor' for anchor products only.

tools.name: get_volume_products
tools.description: Retrieves a list of volume products, each associated with a unique product entity such as 'fusioncompiler' representing 'dgplt'. It also returns the active branches for the product entity within the specified date range.

crm_id.description: The unique identifier assigned to the product by Synopsys.

days.description: The number of days from the current date to determine the range for retrieving volume products.

end_date.description: The end date up to which valid volume products should be fetched, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

tools.name: get_product_info
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information for a Synopsys product using its unique CRM ID.

crm_id.description: The unique identifier for Synopsys products.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of product fields to retrieve, such as 'name,category,price'.

tools.name: reviews.food
tools.description: Collect user reviews and star ratings for food items.

reviews.description: User's written review of the food item.

star_rating.description: User's star rating for the food item, on a scale of 1 to 5.

tools.name: type.of.food
tools.description: Categorize the type of food into predefined categories based on its characteristics.

type.description: The general classification of food, such as 'fruit', 'vegetable', 'meat', 'dairy', or 'grain'.

tools.name: product_list.retrieve
tools.description: Retrieve a list of all xVG product names available in the catalog.

availability.description: A flag to filter products based on availability. When true, only products in stock are listed.

category.description: The category filter to list products from specific categories only.

limit.description: The maximum number of product names to retrieve.

sort_order.description: The order in which the products should be sorted in the list. Possible values are ascending (asc) or descending (desc).

tools.name: get_business_unit_mapping
tools.description: Retrieve the mapping of business unit IDs (bu_id) to their corresponding names (bu_name) for all business units.

tools.name: product_selector.get_products
tools.description: Retrieves a list of products for use in the SLA Dashboard and Patch Self Service, with an option to filter by anchor status.

anchor.description: Filter to indicate if the retrieved products should be all products, user-associated products, or anchor products. Use 'all' for all products, 'user' for products associated with the current user, and 'anchor' for anchor products.

tools.name: sce_api.get_products
tools.description: Retrieve a list of products that have Service Level Agreement (SLA) metrics tracking enabled.

anchor.description: Filter to indicate if the returned products should be all products, only those assigned to the user, or only anchor products. 'all' returns every product with SLA enabled, 'user' returns user-specific products, and 'anchor' returns products marked as anchors.

tools.name: product_volume.get_active_branches
tools.description: Retrieves active branches for a specific product within a given date range. Each product is represented by a unique ID, and branches are considered active if they fall within the specified date range.

crm_id.description: The unique Synopsys product ID assigned to this product.

days.description: The number of days from the current date to calculate the active volume products. For example, specifying 30 would retrieve products active in the last 30 days.

end_date.description: The end date up to which valid volume products should be retrieved, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

tools.name: sce_api.get_product_information
tools.description: Retrieve information for a specific product from the Synopsys Customer Entitlement (SCE) system using the product's CRM ID.

crm_id.description: The unique identifier for Synopsys products.

fields.description: Comma-separated names of the product info fields to retrieve, such as 'name,version,status'.

tools.name: EventSettingsApi.get_alerts
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all alert configurations set up within the system, including their conditions and notification settings.

filter_by.description: Optional filter to apply to the alert configurations returned, e.g., filtering by alert type such as 'error', 'warning', or 'info'.

include_disabled.description: Flag to include disabled alert configurations in the result set.

sort_order.description: The order in which the alert configurations should be returned. Can be 'ascending' or 'descending'.

tools.name: open_asset
tools.description: Opens an asset specified by the user using commands such as 'Go to', 'Select', 'Fly to'. Ensures that the asset name matches one of the predefined asset names in a case-sensitive manner. Prompts the user for clarification if the input is ambiguous or incorrect.

all_regions.description: Whether to open all regions within the asset. True opens all regions, false opens none.

asking_for_region_info.description: True if the user is requesting information about the region names, otherwise false.

asset_name.description: The exact, case-sensitive name of the asset to open. Must match one of the predefined names.

region_names.description: A comma-separated list of region names to open, formatted as 'Region1,Region2'. Optional.

tools.name: query_amap_info
tools.description: Retrieve location information from Amap (Gaode Map) based on a given address or coordinates.

batch.description: A boolean to specify whether to perform batch queries.

city.description: The city name to help narrow down the search, such as 'Beijing', 'Shanghai'.

output.description: The output format of the query result.

query.description: The address or coordinates to query. Coordinates should be in the format 'longitude,latitude'.

radius.description: Search radius in meters, used when a precise location isn't provided.

tools.name: say
tools.description: Broadcast a message in the chat to all participants.

message.description: The message to be broadcasted in the chat.

tools.name: plan
tools.description: Articulate a strategic plan detailing the steps to achieve specific goals, providing the rationale for the chosen approach.

how.description: Detailed step-by-step actions required to attain the desired goals.

what.description: The final objectives or outcomes that the plan aims to achieve.

why.description: The reasoning behind choosing this specific plan of action over alternatives.

tools.name: no_op
tools.description: A placeholder function that performs no operation and returns no value. It can be used as a stub in code where a specific function interface is required but no action is desired.

tools.name: move_to
tools.description: Move an object to a specified 3D coordinate (x, y, z).

x.description: The x coordinate (horizontal axis) to move to, in units.

y.description: The y coordinate (vertical axis) to move to, in units.

z.description: The z coordinate (depth axis) to move to, in units.

tools.name: toss_item
tools.description: Remove an item of a specified type from the player's inventory.

item_type.description: The unique identifier for the type of item to be removed from the inventory.

tools.name: look
tools.description: Adjust the viewing angle of the camera to a specific orientation defined by yaw and pitch values in radians.

pitch.description: The angle in radians to point up or down. 0 radians means straight forward. Positive values up to pi/2 radians mean pointing upwards, and negative values down to -pi/2 radians mean pointing downwards.

yaw.description: The angle in radians for rotation around the vertical axis, starting from due east and rotating counter-clockwise.

tools.name: look_at
tools.description: Orients the view to focus on a specific 3D coordinate in a virtual space.

x.description: The x coordinate (horizontal axis) to look at. It is specified in meters.

y.description: The y coordinate (vertical axis) to look at. It is specified in meters.

z.description: The z coordinate (depth axis) to look at. It is specified in meters.

tools.name: fetch_user_details
tools.description: Retrieves details of a user from the database based on the provided user identification criteria.

date_format.description: The format in which to return any date fields, such as 'YYYY-MM-DD' or 'MM/DD/YYYY'.

fields.description: A list of additional field names to include in the response, such as ['email', 'phone_number'].

include_address.description: Specifies whether to include the user's address information in the response.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user.

tools.name: search_on_google
tools.description: Performs a search on Google with various parameters to filter and customize the search results.

c2coff.description: Enables or disables Simplified and Traditional Chinese search. '1' enables, '0' disables.

cr.description: Restrict search results to documents originating from a specific country. Use a country code string like 'countryUS'.

dateRestrict.description: Restricts results to URLs based on date. Formats include 'd[number]' for days, 'w[number]' for weeks, 'm[number]' for months, and 'y[number]' for years.

exactTerms.description: Specifies a phrase that all documents in the search results must contain.

excludeTerms.description: Specifies a word or phrase that should not appear in any document in the search results.

fileType.description: Restricts results to files of a specified extension such as 'pdf', 'doc', etc.

filter.description: Controls the activation or deactivation of the duplicate content filter. '0' disables, '1' enables.

gl.description: End user's geolocation, specified as a two-letter country code, to optimize search results for that country.

highRange.description: Specifies the final value of a search range for the query.

hl.description: Sets the language of the user interface for the search results.

hq.description: Appends specified query terms to the search as if combined with an AND logical operator.

imgColorType.description: Returns images in specified color type: color, grayscale, mono, or transparent.

imgDominantColor.description: Returns images with a specific dominant color.

imgSize.description: Returns images of a specified size.

imgType.description: Returns images of a specified type: clipart, face, lineart, stock, photo, or animated.

linkSite.description: Specifies that all search results must contain a link to a specific URL.

lowRange.description: Specifies the initial value of a search range for the query.

lr.description: Restricts the search to documents written in a specific language, specified by the 'lang_' prefix followed by the ISO two-letter language code.

num.description: The number of search results to return per page. Must be between 1 and 10.

orTerms.description: Provides additional search terms where each document must contain at least one of the terms.

rights.description: Filters based on licensing, such as 'cc_publicdomain' or 'cc_attribute'.

safe.description: The safety level of the search. 'active' enables, 'off' disables SafeSearch filtering.

searchType.description: Specifies the type of search, such as 'image' for image searches.

siteSearch.description: Specifies a particular site to always include or exclude from the results.

siteSearchFilter.description: Controls inclusion or exclusion of results from the site specified in 'siteSearch'. 'e' excludes, 'i' includes.

sort.description: The sorting expression to apply to the results, such as 'sort=date' to sort by date.

start.description: The index of the first search result to return, starting at 1.

tools.name: make_webapi_call
tools.description: Executes a call to a specified Web API endpoint with given parameters and returns the response.

body.description: The JSON payload to be sent with POST, PUT, or PATCH requests.

data.description: The actual data to be sent in the request body.

endpoint.description: The URL of the Web API endpoint to be called.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request.

Content-Type.description: The media type of the resource being requested or submitted.

method.description: The HTTP method to be used for the API call.

params.description: Query parameters to be appended to the endpoint URL.

query.description: The search term for the query.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for a server response before timing out.

tools.name: pet_profile.create
tools.description: Creates a profile for a pet, including details about the pet and its owner.

owner_email.description: The owner's email address. Leave empty if the email is not provided.

owner_name.description: The full name of the pet's owner.

owner_phone.description: The owner's phone number in the format (XXX) XXX-XXXX, such as '(123) 456-7890'. If not provided, leave as null.

pet_age.description: The age of the pet in years.

pet_breed.description: The breed of the pet, if known; otherwise, specify 'unknown'.

pet_type.description: The type of the pet, for example, 'dog', 'cat', etc.

vaccinated.description: Indicates if the pet is vaccinated. Default to false if vaccination status is unknown.

tools.name: user_authentication.verify
tools.description: Verifies if the provided user credentials are valid and returns an authorization token if the credentials are correct.

login_attempts.description: The number of unsuccessful login attempts made. After 5 attempts, the account will be locked.

password.description: The secret password associated with the username. Must be at least 8 characters long.

remember_me.description: A flag indicating whether the user's session should be persisted across browser restarts.

username.description: The unique identifier for the user, typically an email address.

tools.name: cleanup_logs
tools.description: Searches for and deletes log files within a specified directory that are older than a specified number of days.

age_limit.description: The age of the log files to delete in days. Files older than this will be deleted. For example, 20 represents log files older than 20 days.

file_extension.description: The file extension of log files to target, without the dot. For example, 'log' for files ending in .log.

path.description: The file path to the directory containing log files. For example, '/var/log/myapp/'.

recursive.description: Whether to search for log files recursively within subdirectories.

simulate.description: A flag to simulate the deletion process without actually deleting the files. Set to true for a dry run.

tools.name: chat_completions
tools.description: Processes a series of user messages and generates a chat completion using a specified language model.

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion.

messages.description: An array of user message objects, where each message can be a simple string or a structured object containing blocks of text.

model.description: The identifier of the language model to be used for generating completions.

stop_sequences.description: Optional sequences where the model should stop generating further tokens.

tools.name: generate_completion
tools.description: Generates a text completion based on a given prompt and model input, with a specified maximum number of tokens. Supports various AI models.

assist.description: The type of assistance provided by the AI model.

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate.

model_input.description: The model to be used for generating the completion.

prompt.description: The input text prompt to generate completion from.

tools.name: generation_claude
tools.description: Generates a message using the Claude model with specified parameters, such as the prompt and model configuration.

assist.description: Flag to enable or disable assistance mode in the generation.

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate for the message.

model.description: The specific Claude model variant to use for generation, e.g., 'claude-3-haiku-20240307'.

prompt.description: The input text prompt to guide the generation of the message.

system.description: The system or framework being used for the message generation.

temperature.description: Controls the randomness of the generation. 0 is deterministic.

tools.name: compute_tax
tools.description: Calculates the tax based on the taxable income and filing status of an individual. It also considers the state of residence to apply state-specific tax rules.

deductions.description: The total amount of deductions the individual is claiming, which will reduce the taxable income, in USD.

exemptions.description: The number of exemptions claimed by the taxpayer, reducing the taxable income further.

filing_status.description: The taxpayer's filing status which determines the rate at which income is taxed.

state_of_residence.description: The U.S. state where the taxpayer is a resident, which affects the calculation of state taxes.

tax_year.description: The tax year for which the tax calculation is being performed. It defaults to the current year if not specified.

taxable_income.description: The individual's income subject to tax, before any deductions or exemptions, in USD.

tools.name: getIncomeStatement
tools.description: Retrieves real-time income statement data for a wide range of companies. This data can help assess a company's profitability over time, compare it with competitors, and identify business trends.

cik.description: The SEC-assigned Central Index Key (CIK) number of the company. Example: '0000320193' for Apple Inc.

datatype.description: The format of the returned data, either 'json' or 'csv'.

headers.description: Optional headers for the API request, such as API keys. If not provided, defaults will be used.

Authorization.description: API key for authorization, prefixed by 'Bearer ' if required.

Content-Type.description: The content type of the request, typically 'application/json'.

limit.description: Limits the number of income statements returned to manage response size. Example: 100 for the last 100 statements.

period.description: The reporting period for the data, either 'annual' or 'quarter'.

symbol.description: The stock symbol of the company. Example: 'AAPL' for Apple Inc.

timeout.description: The timeout for the request in seconds, determining how long to wait for the server to send data before timing out.

url.description: The API endpoint for accessing income statement data, offering insights into financial performance. Example: 'https://financialmodelingprep.com/api/v3/income-statement/'.

tools.name: user_details.update
tools.description: Updates the user's account details with new information provided. This operation will overwrite the existing details with the supplied values.

address.description: The new address for the user, including street, city, state, and postal code (e.g., '123 Maple St, Springfield, IL, 62704').

email.description: The new email address for the user account.

phone_number.description: The new phone number for the user, formatted as an international dialing number (e.g., '+1-555-1234').

preferences.description: A dictionary of user-specific preferences such as language and notification settings.

language.description: The preferred language for the user interface, represented by a locale code (e.g., 'en-US' for American English).

notifications.description: Whether the user has opted in to receive email notifications.

subscription_status.description: The subscription status of the user's account.

user_id.description: The unique identifier for the user whose details are to be updated.

tools.name: SimpleQuestion.ask
tools.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

tools.name: send_get_request
tools.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data based on the provided parameters.

auth.description: HTTP authentication credentials as an array where the first element is the username and the second is the password.

cert.description: Path to a cert file or key for SSL verification.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request.

name.description: The name of the cookie.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol to the proxy URL.

stream.description: Indicates if the response should be streamed (True) or immediately downloaded (False).

timeout.description: The maximum number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

tools.name: set_ac_state
tools.description: Set the state of the air conditioner by adjusting the temperature, mode, fan speed, and fan position to achieve the desired comfort level.

fan_position.description: Fan position level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest and 5 is the highest.

fan_speed.description: Fan speed level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest speed and 5 is the highest.

temperature.description: Desired temperature setting for the air conditioner in degrees Celsius.

tools.name: get_ac_state
tools.description: Fetch the current operational state of the air conditioner, including mode, temperature settings, and power status. If 'unit_id' is not provided, the default air conditioner unit will be queried.

include_diagnostics.description: Whether to include diagnostic information in the response.

unit_id.description: The unique identifier of the air conditioner unit. If omitted, the system will fetch the state of the default AC unit.

tools.name: getUserInfo
tools.description: Retrieve the user information associated with a given user ID.

userId.description: The unique identifier of the user for which information is being requested.

tools.name: getItemInfo
tools.description: Retrieves the name and price of an item based on its unique identifier.

itemId.description: The unique identifier of the item.

tools.name: compute_statistics
tools.description: This function calculates key statistical measures, such as the mean, median, and mode, of a given dataset.

data.description: An array of numerical values for which statistical measures will be computed.

decimal_places.description: The number of decimal places to round the computed statistics to. The default is 2 decimal places.

include_variance.description: A flag indicating whether to include variance in the output. By default, variance is not included.

tools.name: run_ireg
tools.description: Executes the integrated regression (ireg) process for a specified product.

prod.description: The product code for which the ireg process should be executed. Valid product codes include 'fc' for Full Chip, 'starrc' for Star RC extraction, 'pt' for PrimeTime timing analysis, and 'nt' for NanoTime timing analysis.

tools.name: doc_qa
tools.description: This function provides an answer to a user's question based on the content of a specific English-language document. It analyzes the document's information to find the most relevant answer to the question.

context_length.description: The number of surrounding words to include with the answer for context.

document_content.description: The full text of the document to search for the answer.

include_confidence.description: Whether to include the model's confidence score with the answer.

prompt.description: The question posed by the user about the document.

tools.name: code_explain
tools.description: Provides a detailed explanation of the specified code snippet or addresses a question related to the code from the script editor.

context.description: Additional context or information related to the code snippet which can help in generating a better explanation.

language.description: The programming language of the code snippet.

prompt.description: The code snippet selected by the user or a question regarding the code that needs explanation.

tools.name: attach_script
tools.description: Generates a code script based on a given prompt, which can be used for automating tasks or integrating into a larger codebase.

add_comments.description: Indicates if explanatory comments should be included in the generated script.

language.description: The programming language for the generated script.

prompt_script.description: The textual requirement or description from which to generate the code script.

script_type.description: The type of script to be generated, such as 'standalone' or 'module'.

tools.name: create_material
tools.description: Creates a new material entry based on the provided text description. Common materials include doors, metal components, etc.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the material required, specified in the format 'Width x Height x Depth' in inches. For example, '24 x 78 x 1.5' for a door.

material_type.description: The category of material to be created.

prompt_material.description: The text description that specifies the material requirements. For example, 'oak wood door' or 'stainless steel panel'.

quantity.description: The number of material units required. Unit refers to the countable quantity of the material, such as '5 doors' or '20 panels'.

tools.name: search_insert_assert
tools.description: This function searches for a specific item described by the user's query and inserts it into an appropriate location in the system.

location.description: The location where the item will be inserted, specified in the format 'section/shelf'.

priority.description: A flag indicating whether the item should be inserted with high priority.

query.description: The description of the item to be searched and inserted.
